name: Polaris RZR Pro
blurb: The Pro chassis with longer travel suspension, aimed at drivers who already know the route.

durations.label: 30 minutes
durations.blurb: The lowest commitment. Enough to learn the controls and cross a few dune faces on the Polaris RZR Pro.

durations.label: 1 hour
durations.blurb: The sweet spot for most riders. Time to settle into the Polaris RZR Pro and get a proper run at the red dunes.

durations.label: 2 hours
durations.blurb: A longer route with more varied terrain and photo stops, for riders already comfortable on the Polaris RZR Pro.
